fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix Inc (NASDAQ:SKHY) rose 3.8% to $127.30 in early trading, buoyed by Nvidia's strong earnings and benefiting from high-bandwidth memory (HBM) supply.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia's memory supply commitment increased from $279B to $390B, expanding multi-year memory procurement and enhancing SK Hynix's revenue visibility.
